newsitem.title: POLAND: Change in Polish CPI measure kept y/y figure flat.
newsitem.headline: Change in Polish CPI measure kept y/y figure flat.

text.p: Poland's Central Statistical Office's said changes in its consumer goods basket kept the year-on-year CPI index flat at 19.5 percent in October despite a drop in the monthly figure against the same month last year. Dorota Turek, head of the Office's (GUS) price department told Reuters the changes in the basket were done annually, with the last one in January 1996.
"The consumer price index is calculated in a farmula, where weights are based on the structure of people's spending on cunsumer goods and services from the year before," Turek said.
"The system of weights (within the basket of consumer goods) was revised in January this year," she said.
GUS reported earlier the year-on-year CPI index was flat 19.5 percent in October against September even though the month-on-month inflation was 1.4 percent and in October 1995 it was 1.8 percent.
